violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Plastic spoons stored laying in dessert topping at ice cream station.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Open package of deli meat and commercial potato salad in 2 door cooler is not date marked.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Using cloths as drying mats under ice cream machine parts.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Frost build up at interiors of multiple upright freezers.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Ice scoop on the front counter was stored in water.
Contaminated food disposition. — --Contaminated ready-to-eat food was not discarded as required. Container of peaches in the walk in cooler dated August 14th had mold on them, and not discarded.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Paper on on top of the dessert case were not inverted.
